title: cairnmap retires and help is the one help surface
intention: The cairnmap tool is deleted: `cairn help` is the one help surface, edges reads charters itself, and the skill node class names no cairnmap derivation gate.
why: Akien's outline answer Q#49 (2026-11-06), at 19.6 of CairnComponentOutline[BACKUP].txt: 'cairnmap: RETIRE. An old version of help (2.4.2); it goes away, code deleted (1.2.7).' Measured 2026-11-08: `bin/cairn cairnmap --gate` raises TypeError, so the skill class's prove_gate that names it has not been runnable.
how: Extend the shared retirement proof with four teeth (red first); delete the tool and its command; edges carries its own walk; the intent proof loses the two cairnmap teeth; charters, PROOF.md files, comments and prose stop naming it; the commons node classes drop the gate.

clauses.claim: no repo file outside records of truth and caches names cairn.tools.cairnmap, cairn/tools/cairnmap, bin/cmd/cairnmap, `cairn cairnmap` or `cairnmap --gate`
importing cairn.tools.cairnmap.cairnmap exits nonzero with No module named
the skill and code-seam node classes in the commons name no cairnmap

decisions.text: D1: extend the red-first proof bin/proofs/test_retired_components_are_gone.py with PROVES['d547b4859f9a'] = {'1': 'cairnmap_paths_are_absent', '2': 'nothing_names_cairnmap', '3': 'cairnmap_does_not_import', '4': 'no_node_class_names_cairnmap'} and a _cairnmap() called from check(). Tooth 1: cairn/tools/cairnmap and bin/cmd/cairnmap are absent. Tooth 2: _naming over ('cairn.tools.' + 'cairnmap', 'cairn/tools/' + 'cairnmap', 'bin/cmd/' + 'cairnmap', 'cairn ' + 'cairnmap', 'cairnmap' + ' --gate') (each spelled split) finds nothing. Tooth 3: importing cairn.tools.cairnmap.cairnmap exits nonzero with 'No module named'. Tooth 4: in Path(address.ROOTS['commons']) / 'node_classes', skill.json and code-seam.json do not contain 'cairnmap' (case folded). _naming's skipped records gain cairn/tools/intentions_model_compiler/probes/dated_append_judgments.json by file name (it is the present-tense sweep's record of past judgments, read by test_present_tense_sweep.py, whose pairs name what passed through, never callers), named in its docstring with this ticket. The earlier tickets' teeth are unchanged. Run red before the build: all four FAIL.

D2: delete cairn/tools/cairnmap/ whole and bin/cmd/cairnmap: its intention+why.json, history.json, state.json and validations/*.json leave first through bin/cairn artifact remove <path> --why 'ticket d547b4859f9a: cairnmap retires (Q#49)'; git rm the rest.

D3: cairn/tools/edges/edges.py drops the cairnmap import and carries its own walk: CHARTER = 'intention+why.json'; roots_parent() reads CAIRN_ROOTS_PARENT else Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]; repo_root() = roots_parent() / 'cairn'; commons_root() = roots_parent() / 'CairnCommons'; _charters(repo) is the moved gather body (sorted rglob of CHARTER skipping dot and __pycache__ parts, an unreadable charter a red naming its path, entries {path, rel, dir, data}). gather_edges calls _charters(repo or repo_root()); gather_questions uses commons_root(). The docstring says it walks the charters itself. cairn/tools/edges/proofs/test_edges.py's docstring and comments say edges' own walk and seam (not cairnmap's). cairn/tools/edges/intention+why.json (write_json, verb append): what/why/entry say the gather/project pattern and the CAIRN_ROOTS_PARENT seam are edges' own, with no cairnmap; traces_to gains 'ticket d547b4859f9a (Q#49)'.

D4: skills/intent/proofs/test_intent_skill.py: delete test_the_skill_class_derivation_gate_is_green and test_clause_1_the_command_lane_carries_no_reds; drop key '1' from PROVES['c691e19d5464']; test_clause_3 reads installed = {p.name: (p.resolve() if p.exists() else None) for p in (Path.home() / '.claude' / 'skills').iterdir()} instead of cairnmap.installed_skills(). The module docstring's two paragraphs about the derivation gate and the hermetic/host-wide teeth become one: the derivation gate and the command lane retired with cairnmap (ticket d547b4859f9a, outline Q#49: help is `cairn help`, 2.4.2); clauses 2-4 of c691e19d5464 stand. skills/intent/proofs/PROOF.md's stale-IOU section says the same in one paragraph, with no needle.
